independent_assessment.independence_statement: Assessor reviewed the design and amendment but did not author or modify candidate guidance, fixtures, worker tasks or application behavior. Scoring used raw records and role reports; organizer result interpretations and observations.json were not used. No application tests were rerun. Only the two requested independent assessment deliverables were written.

threshold.rule: At least two paired unchanged workflows spanning both fixtures, no opposite-direction excess, and no critical failure in the benefiting arm. A threshold match supports a bounded adoption discussion, not automatic activation.

B_vs_A.interpretation: Reviewer delivery removes reviewer reruns but leaves one controller rerun per clean workflow; it does not satisfy the two-fixture improvement condition.

C_vs_B.interpretation: C avoids all three additional clean controller suites seen in B while all clean workflows retain bounded independent coverage judgments and complete status.

independent_assessment.recommendation: C meets the prespecified bounded benefit threshold beyond B with no observed assurance regression on the scored indicators. Carry C forward to an adoption discussion; this study alone does not establish general safety or authorize an active-skill switch. B does not meet the preset cross-fixture threshold.

disposition: Carry C forward for remaining delivery validation; hold retirement and activation. Debugging and testing candidates require separate evaluation.
